title: Boiler Service History
description: Service history and upcoming schedule for the Bosch Condens 5000 W gas boiler. Each record captures the service date, engineer, gas meter reading, any findings, and the next scheduled service date.

appliance_id.description: Reference to the appliances table entry for the Bosch Condens 5000 W

service_date.description: Date the service was performed, ISO 8601

engineer_name.description: Name of the engineer who performed the service

engineer_company.description: Company the engineer works for, e.g. ThermoFix Akis

gas_meter_reading_m3.description: Gas meter reading in cubic meters at time of service

next_service_due.description: Next service deadline, ISO 8601 — typically one year after the service date

findings.description: Any issues found or notes from the service visit

contract_active.description: Whether the annual service contract is currently active
